TGO.note: The chatbot for school results is not said to be AI, and it is an education-sector tool.
No data link between education systems is stated; Exasco only moves exam copies between regions.

facts.fact: The ministry's CNDP-TICE says the education information system (SIGE) now steers the education sector through real-time data collection.

TGO.note: SIGE is named with real-time collection, but no school-level entry or learner records are described.
